rationales.authenticity: Herbal remedies (yarrow, raspberry leaf) are period-authentic; tension with priest is historically resonant.
rationales.character: Confident, thoughtful midwife who respects church but defers to practical experience and compassion.
rationales.craft: Three sentences, balanced; philosophical stance tempered with practical action; strong voice.
rationales.language: Well-formed English with Irish term; no non-Latin script; diction remains grounded.
rationales.responsiveness: Addresses the priest's preaching and defends traditional remedies, though redirect to tea-selling slightly weakens.
